response.sql: WITH type_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM type_rates) SELECT tr.Name, tr.rate, tr.track_count, tr.rate - mr.rate AS rate_above_mean FROM type_rates AS tr CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS mr WHERE tr.rate > mr.rate;

assumptions.assumption: A media type is identified by MediaTypeId, so types sharing a name are counted separately. Undefined rates are excluded from the mean.
